mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates compress discount rates applied to equity cash flows and increase valuation multiples.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a shift toward monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235) and weak consumer spending (RSAFS < 450000) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 235 and RSAFS < 450000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market regime where unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% and is rising (UNRATE change > 0.1% in 3 months), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 trading days due to recessionary fears.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0% AND UNRATE change > 0.1% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The level of unemployment rate (UNRATE) is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher unemployment indicates economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings potential.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units, it signals weak consumer demand and economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1200), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of weak industrial production (INDPRO < 105) and low housing starts (HOUST < 1200) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105 and HOUST < 1200, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply regime where industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
